events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with four possible scenarios for geopolitics after the war. The US is showing military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The Middle East is a powder keg of instability and strategic rivalries.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased volatility in the markets, with a potential safe haven bid for gold. Emerging markets may be negatively impacted by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Watch for a potential de-escalation of the conflict

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when gold prices reach $2,000/oz

gains.extendedNote: If the conflict spreads to other regions
